feeds.title: Dementia Help UK
feeds.description: A free source of information, tips and advice on caring for a loved one with dementia. Helping carers cope. Founded by writer and author, Christina Neal.

feeds.title: Let's Talk about Dementia
feeds.description: Let's Talk about Dementia was set up following on from Scotland's Dementia Awareness Week 2014 which focussed on the theme 'lets talk about dementia'. It covers a range of topics and offer practical ideas, hint and tips, share allied health professionals' knowledge and expertise.

feeds.title: QCS Blog » Dementia
feeds.description: Read all the latest posts on Dementia - our expert's insights keep you up to date on the latest news and opinions in the Care Industry. We make compliance management easy so you can spend less time on paperwork and more time delivering care. We empower care providers to deliver higher-quality care and build a caring world.

feeds.title: Ambiance Care Blog
feeds.description: Ambiance care is a specialist home care provider covering Stockport and East Cheshire, dedicated to and passionate about supporting people living with dementia or memory difficulties and their families. Read our blog for information and resources to help you and your loved ones.

feeds.title: Dementia Matters In Powys Blog
feeds.description: DMP news and updates in the blog from Dementia Matters in Powys! We've been working hard to promote our cause and we have been focused on the development and running of accessible and inclusive Meeting Centres.

feeds.title: Simon's Cognitive Stimulation Therapy Activities Blog
feeds.description: Simon's Dementia CST Activities Blog offers a free and open-access cognitive stimulation therapy activities resource, with a library of off-the-shelf themed pages. The main aim of this website is to share experiences and resources freely.

feeds.title: Dementia Change Action Network Blog
feeds.description: DCAN is an open, collaborative network. Together we all see, hear, think, learn and achieve more. We use the power of networks to tackle key challenges for people with dementia. Read all about Dementia and our network through our blog!

feeds.title: The Relish Dementia Blog
feeds.description: The Relish dementia blog focuses on tips and advice on activities for those with dementia. Learn more about dementia and ongoing research into the syndrome. Relish is designed to bring joy to life with Dementia. Our mission is to help improve the overall wellbeing of people with dementia by providing fun, meaningful activities that help build their relationships with their family, friends, and caregivers.

feeds.title: DPUK Blog
feeds.description: Browse our blog for an insight into the vital work our researchers are doing to tackle dementia. We also explain more about the different types, symptoms and risk factors of dementia, busting the jargon and offering helpful tips and advice.

feeds.title: Dementia Support Blog
feeds.description: Discover the latest information and advice for families living with dementia from Dementia Support. It was set up to provide a vital service offering support, guidance, and care for those in our community living with dementia.

feeds.title: Association For Dementia Studies Blog
feeds.description: Association for Dementia Studies (ADS) works to improve the lives of people living with dementia, their families, and those who work to support them. It is an active research and education center at the University of Worcester. Read our blog to know more about us, how we work, what we do, and more!

feeds.title: Living With Dementia
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Pete Middleton. In my blog, Living With Dementia, I document my journey into dementia and show how I cope day-to-day with the challenges of this chronic disease that steals memories and strips away abilities. Please come along with me for the ride, and together we will experience the ups and downs of life after diagnosis.

feeds.title: The Lewy Body Society News
feeds.description: The Lewy Body Society, established in June 2006, is the only charity in Europe exclusively concerned with dementia with Lewy bodies. The charity's mission is to raise awareness of DLB for the general public and educate those in the medical profession and decision making positions about all aspects of the disease and to support research into the disease.

feeds.title: Dementia Forward Blog
feeds.description: The latest news, information, and stories from Dementia Forward, your local dementia charity. We're a leading dementia charity for York and North Yorkshire. We provide support, advice, and information to anybody affected by dementia across the county, and have developed a comprehensive range of services; all with people living with dementia at their heart.

feeds.title: Too Young for Dementia Blog
feeds.description: Too Young for Dementia Blog is a story of a young 54-year-old's journey with a diagnosis of early-onset Alzheimer's.

feeds.title: Dementia Adventure Blog
feeds.description: Dementia Adventure aims for a more active and fulfilled life for everyone living with dementia. Our mission is to support people with dementia to get outdoors and experience the benefits of nature. Get to know all about us through our blogs!

feeds.title: Dementia Club UK Blog
feeds.description: You will find here a list of our blog articles on our Care Meeting, recipes, sessions, etc. Dementia Club UK goes above and beyond to provide help and support to those living with dementia and also their carers and families to put smiles on their faces and give them a better quality of life.

feeds.title: Dementia Cafe
feeds.description: Our Founder Emily-Jane Stapley, established the Dementia Cafe charity in 2015 after her Mother had been diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Having a cup of tea and a chat, in the right space, where daily challenges were removed, could make a difference. Dementia Café Meetups focus on breaking down barriers, feeling ok, joining other's socially without worry and without judgement, being able to be happy for a couple of hours.

feeds.title: Which Me Am I Today Blog
feeds.description: Which Me Am I Today is a blog personal blog by Wendy Mitchell. She shares her personal experiences of living with dementia. She was diagnosed on 31 July 2014. She is the proud author of the Sunday times best-seller- Somebody I used to know.

feeds.title: Local Dementia Guide
feeds.description: Local Dementia Guide will help you to find local dementia support and resources in your area.

feeds.title: D4Dementia
feeds.description: Beth aims to provide support and advice through D4Dementia to those faced with vascular dementia and similar situations, inform and educate care professionals and the wider population, promote debate and create improvements in dementia care.

feeds.title: Dementia UK
feeds.description: Dementia UK is a national charity, committed to improving quality of life for all people affected by dementia. We provide mental health nurses specialising in dementia care, called Admiral Nurses.

feeds.title: Innovations In Dementia Blogs
feeds.description: We work with other organizations to help people with dementia to keep control of their lives and be happy. Read more about the beliefs and values behind our work on our blog page!

feeds.title: Multi-Species Dementia Blog
feeds.description: The Multi-Species Dementia International Research Network provides a forum for exploring how relations with the 'more than the human world' shape our understanding of dementia. Get to know all the details about Dementia on our blog!

feeds.title: Lewy Body Dementia UK Blog
feeds.description: We are solely for the purpose of sharing information in regards to support networks, careers contacts and links to many important legitimate professional sources and valuable listings concerning Lewy Body Dementia itself. Lewy Body Dementia UK is a non-profit, non-charity, un-registered and non-professional blog.

feeds.title: Helping Hands Home Care Blog » Dementia Care
feeds.description: Read the latest news and blog posts about dementia care and the customers we're supporting every day so they can continue to live in their homes. Our mission is to provide quality support and care to enable people to remain in their own homes and pursue their chosen lifestyles regardless of age, disability, and geographical area.

feeds.title: Dementia Friendly Swansea Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with the latest news at Dementia Friendly Swansea with our blog! Dementia Friendly Swansea focuses on improving the quality of life for people living with dementia. Our mission is to create a Dementia friendly community.

feeds.title: Dementia Friendly Worthing Blog
feeds.description: Know about different Dementia centers, what happens there, dementia-friendly school videos, and more! Dementia Friendly Worthing started as the Worthing Area Dementia Forum in October 2013 organizing bi-monthly public meetings at Guild Care and the Worthing Alzheimer Society's head offices. Supported by Carers Support West Sussex and Coastal West Sussex Mind, we set out to establish a dementia-friendly community in the Worthing area.

feeds.title: Hertswise Blog
feeds.description: Hertswise is an innovative countywide service designed to support people living with dementia, low-level memory loss, or mild cognitive impairment as well as their loved ones and carers. Our teams aim to ensure that people of all ages, living anywhere in Hertfordshire, can easily access information and advice, activities, and support regardless of whether they have (or want) a diagnosis.

feeds.title: Abney and Baker Blog
feeds.description: We are family-owned, local, and proud of the role we play in our community. Our mission is to make personal support as flexible and as easy to access as booking a haircut or dentist's appointment. We're there when you need us. Read updates, information, and the latest news about Dementia on Abney and Baker's Blog!

feeds.title: 3Nations Dementia Working Group s & Stories Blog
feeds.description: Our Alzheimer's blog and dementia blog has personal stories & articles for dementia sufferers. The 3NDWG is a working group of people living with dementia across England, Northern Ireland, and Wales. Members are based all across the three nations, creating a network of voices on dementia who can lead regional projects.
